title: C1 Milestone 1: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el Primer Hito del Nivel C1. Ya puedes usar Cleft Sentences para dar énfasis y dominar el vocabulario de la alta dirección. ¡Estás hablando como un verdadero CEO!

parts.visual:
En este hito repasaremos las lecciones 1 a 4 del nivel C1: 
- Cleft Sentences (What I need is time / It was John who...). 
- Ellipsis & Substitution (I hope so / I am afraid not / Some did, others didn't).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 1 to 4 of the C1 level: Cleft Sentences for emphasis, such as 'What I need is time' or 'It was John who did it'. We will also review Ellipsis and Substitution, like 'I hope so' or 'I am afraid not'.

parts.visual:
También evaluaremos tu uso de vocabulario de nivel directivo: 
- C-Level & Boardroom (Takeover bid, oust, golden parachute, due diligence). 
- Advanced Idioms (Bite the bullet, elephant in the room, move the goalposts). 
¡Demuestra que tienes la fluidez y el vocabulario de un alto ejecutivo!
parts.audio: We will also test your use of executive-level vocabulary: C-Level and Boardroom terms, including takeover bid, oust, golden parachute, and due diligence. And Advanced Idioms, with phrases like bite the bullet, elephant in the room, and move the goalposts. Show that you have the fluency and vocabulary of a top executive!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío C1.

questions.question:
Normal: I hate his arrogance. 
Emphasis: ____ I hate is his arrogance. (Lo que odio es...).
questions.explanation: Cleft sentence: What I hate is...

questions.question: The board of directors decided to ____ the CEO after the scandal. (Destituir / Expulsar).

A: Is the company going bankrupt? 
B: I hope ____! (Espero que no).
We just have to bite the ____ and accept the losses. (Afrontar la difícil situación).
It ____ only yesterday that we found out about the merger. (Fue apenas ayer cuando...).
questions.explanation: Acción pasada (found out) -> It was yesterday that...

questions.question: I would love to stay, but I really don't have time ____. (Para hacerlo - Ellipsis).
Before we sign the contract, we must do our due ____. (Auditoría / Investigación exhaustiva).
It is the lack of communication ____ is ruining this team. (Es la falta de comunicación LO QUE...).
Nobody wants to talk about the massive debt. It is the ____ in the room. (El problema obvio).

A: Will we hit our sales target this quarter? 
B: I am afraid ____. (Me temo que sí).
The company launched a ____ takeover of its biggest rival. (Adquisición hostil).
I haven't written the report yet, but I am going ____ this afternoon. (A hacerlo).
questions.explanation: Ellipsis: I am going to (write it).

questions.question: ____ you need to do is trust the process. (LO ÚNICO que tienes que hacer es...).
questions.explanation: All you need to do is...

questions.question: To put it in a ____, the product was a complete failure. (En pocas palabras).
He said he would finish the project by Friday, but he ____. (No lo hizo).
questions.explanation: Sustitución con auxiliar: but he didn't.

questions.question: The CEO left the company with a massive $20 million golden ____. (Paracaídas dorado).
What happens ____ that the server crashes every morning. (Lo que pasa ES QUE...).
We had the deal closed, but the client moved the ____ at the last minute. (Cambió las reglas).
The company was fined $50 million for insider ____. (Tráfico de información privilegiada).
I don't think they will accept our offer, and our lawyer doesn't think ____ either. (Tampoco lo cree).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave (What, It, so, not, to, etc.) del nivel C1.

questions.question: ____ I need is more money. (Lo que necesito...)
____ was John who did it. (Fue John quien...)
I hope ____. (Espero que sí)
I hope ____. (Espero que no)
He told me not ____. (Que no lo hiciera - preposición)
Bite the ____. (Afrontar lo difícil con B)
Due ____. (Auditoría previa con D)
____ takeover. (Adquisición hostil con H)
In a ____. (En pocas palabras con N)
The ____ of directors. (Junta directiva con B)

pairs.target: El problema obvio que todos ignoran

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración para tu examen final del bloque 1.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: What we need is more time.
options: What we need is more time.
What we need are more time.
What we needed is more time.
That we need is more time.
questions.correct_answer: What we need is more time.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It was John who signed the contract.
options: It was John who signed the contract.
It is John who signed the contract.
It was John what signed the contract.
It was John which signed the contract.
questions.correct_answer: It was John who signed the contract.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.

options: The board of directors approved it.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.

options: We need to do our due diligence.
They need to do our due diligence.
We need to do our diligence.
We needed to do our due diligence.
